title: The Newborn's First Minutes: Transition, APGAR and Resuscitation
next: Chapter 43, Lesson 2: Newborn breathing problems, warmth, low sugar and transport

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already dry, warm and stimulate a newborn, ventilate with a BVM and do infant CPR. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Explain the transition from fetus to newborn, and what delays it
  2. Assess fast: breathing, heart rate, colour, then the APGAR
  3. Run the BC newborn steps, and know where the book goes beyond BC scope

Textbook: Chapter 43, PDF pages 3629–3670
slides.say: Welcome to Chapter 43, the newborn. As EMRs, you already know how to dry, warm and stimulate a newborn, ventilate with a bag-valve mask, and do infant CPR. As a PCP, you'll often be the most senior provider at an unexpected birth, so you need to understand why newborns get into trouble, see it coming, and lead the resuscitation step by step. Today we'll cover three things: the transition from fetus to newborn, a fast newborn assessment including the APGAR score, and the BC newborn resuscitation steps compared with the book.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来到第四十三章：新生儿。作为 EMR，你们已经会给新生儿擦干、保暖、刺激，会用球囊面罩通气，也会做婴儿 CPR。作为 PCP，在意外分娩现场你常常是资历最高的人，所以你要明白新生儿为什么会出问题，提前预判，并一步一步主导复苏。今天讲三件事：从胎儿到新生儿的过渡；新生儿快速评估，包括 Apgar 评分；以及 BC 新生儿复苏步骤，并和原书对比。

slides.title: From fetus to newborn
slides.body:
Cord clamped→first breaths fill the lungs→lung pressure drops, shunts close
  • Before birth: lungs full of fluid, only about 10% of the blood
  • Three bypass shunts: ductus venosus, ductus arteriosus, foramen ovale
  • Transition is slowed by hypoxia, cold and acidosis
  • Also: meconium, sepsis, maternal drugs, C-section without labour
slides.say: Before birth, the baby gets oxygen from the placenta. The lungs are full of fluid and receive only about ten percent of the blood, because three shunts send blood around them: the ductus venosus, the ductus arteriosus and the foramen ovale. At birth, the cord is clamped and the first breaths fill the lungs with air. Pressure in the lung vessels falls, blood starts flowing through the lungs, and the shunts close. This switch is called transition. Anything that keeps lung pressure high slows it down, especially hypoxia, cold and acidosis. So your warming and ventilation aren't just comfort; they help the baby's circulation switch over.
slides.sayZh: 出生前，胎儿从胎盘获得氧气。肺里充满液体，只分到大约百分之十的血，因为有三条分流让血绕开肺：静脉导管、动脉导管和卵圆孔。出生时，脐带被夹闭，最初几口呼吸让肺充满空气。肺血管压力下降，血开始流经肺部，分流关闭。这个转换叫过渡。任何让肺压力居高不下的因素都会拖慢它，尤其是缺氧、寒冷和酸中毒。所以你的保暖和通气不只是让孩子舒服，而是在帮助孩子的循环完成转换。

slides.title: Prepare before the baby arrives
slides.body:
• Ask: weeks, prenatal care, waters broken when, fluid colour
  • Twins? Diabetes or high BP? Drugs or medications?
  • Preterm < 37 weeks; term 37–42; post-term > 42
  • Higher risk: preterm, meconium, breech, prolapsed cord, maternal fever
  • Minimum kit: warm blankets, bulb syringe, 2 clamps, clean scissors
  • Also ready: infant BVM and a hat

About 6–10% of newborns need skilled help; about 80% of those under 1,500 g need resuscitation.
slides.say: Good newborn care starts before the birth. Use any spare minute to ask the questions that predict trouble: how many weeks, prenatal care, when the waters broke and what colour the fluid was, twins, diabetes or high blood pressure, and any drugs or medications. Preterm means under thirty-seven weeks, term is thirty-seven to forty-two, and post-term is over forty-two. About six to ten percent of newborns need skilled help, and about eighty percent of babies under fifteen hundred grams need resuscitation. Get your kit out early: warm dry blankets, a bulb syringe, two clamps and clean scissors at minimum, plus an infant bag-valve mask and a hat.
slides.sayZh: 好的新生儿照护从出生前就开始了。利用任何空闲的一分钟，问那些能预测麻烦的问题：怀孕几周、产检情况、什么时候破水、羊水什么颜色、是不是双胎、有没有糖尿病或高血压、用了什么药或毒品。早产是不足三十七周，足月是三十七到四十二周，过期产是超过四十二周。大约百分之六到十的新生儿需要专业帮助，体重不到一千五百克的孩子约百分之八十需要复苏。提早把装备拿出来：至少要有温暖干燥的毯子、吸球、两把夹子和干净的剪刀，再加上婴儿球囊面罩和一顶帽子。

slides.title: The first 30 seconds
slides.body:
1. Note the time of birth
  2. Dry well, remove wet towels, put on a hat
  3. Skin-to-skin with mother, or warm blankets
  4. On back or side, neck in the sniffing position
  5. Suction only if blocked or before PPV: mouth before nose
  6. Stimulate: flick the soles, rub the back; never slap
slides.say: The first thirty seconds are about warmth, airway and stimulation. Note the time of birth. Dry the baby well, throw away the wet towels, and put on a hat, because a wet newborn loses heat fast, much of it from the head. Then go skin-to-skin on the mother's chest, or wrap the baby in warm blankets. Lay the baby on its back or side with the neck slightly extended, in the sniffing position; a small towel under the shoulders helps. Suction only if something blocks the airway or before you ventilate, mouth first, then nose. Stimulate by flicking the soles or rubbing the back. Never slap or rub roughly.
slides.sayZh: 最初三十秒的重点是保暖、气道和刺激。记下出生时间。把孩子彻底擦干，扔掉湿毛巾，戴上帽子，因为湿的新生儿散热很快，很多热量从头部散失。然后放在母亲胸前皮肤贴皮肤，或者用温暖的毯子包好。让孩子仰卧或侧卧，颈部稍微后仰，呈嗅物位；肩下垫一条小毛巾会有帮助。只有气道被堵住或准备通气前才吸引，先吸口、再吸鼻。刺激的方法是弹足底或搓背。绝不要拍打或用力搓。

slides.title: Fast check: breathing, HR, colour
slides.body:
• HR: stethoscope or the base of the cord; count 6 s × 10
  • Breathing: crying? gasping? Apnea = pause of 20 s or more
  • Blue at birth is normal; the trunk turns pink quickly
  • Blue hands and feet (acrocyanosis) can last for hours
  • SpO₂ on the right hand; reaching 90% takes 6–7 minutes

Decide on resuscitation from these signs. Don't wait for the 1-minute APGAR.
slides.say: Now a fast check of three things: breathing, heart rate and colour. Count the heart rate with a stethoscope, or feel the pulse at the base of the umbilical cord. Count for six seconds and multiply by ten. Is the baby crying, gasping, or not breathing? Apnea in a newborn means a pause of twenty seconds or more. All babies are blue at birth, but the trunk should turn pink quickly. Blue hands and feet, called acrocyanosis, are normal for hours, so judge colour on the chest. Put the oximeter on the right hand. Saturation takes six to seven minutes to pass ninety percent. And don't wait for the APGAR to decide on resuscitation.
slides.sayZh: 现在快速检查三样：呼吸、心率和肤色。用听诊器数心率，或者在脐带根部摸搏动。数六秒再乘以十。孩子在哭、在喘，还是没有呼吸？新生儿的呼吸暂停是指停顿二十秒或更长。所有孩子出生时都是青紫的，但躯干应该很快变红润。手脚发紫叫肢端发绀，可以持续好几个小时，属于正常，所以要看胸部的颜色。血氧探头夹在右手上。血氧要六到七分钟才会超过百分之九十。还有，是否复苏不要等 Apgar 评分来决定。

slides.title: The APGAR score
slides.body:
Sign210
Appearanceall pinkbody pink, limbs blueblue or pale
Pulseover 100under 100none
Grimacecriesgrimacesno response
Activityactivesome flexionlimp
Respirationstrong cryslow, irregularabsent

Score at 1 and 5 minutes. If under 7 at 5 min, repeat every 5 min up to 20 min.
slides.say: The APGAR score describes how the baby is doing at one minute and at five minutes. Five signs each get zero, one or two points: appearance, which is colour; pulse; grimace, the response to stimulation; activity, which is muscle tone; and respiration. A pink baby with blue hands and feet gets one for appearance. A pulse over one hundred gets two, and under one hundred gets one. Most healthy babies score seven or more. If the five-minute score is under seven, repeat it every five minutes, up to twenty minutes. Remember, the APGAR records the baby's condition and response to care; it doesn't decide when you start.
slides.sayZh: Apgar 评分描述孩子在一分钟和五分钟时的状况。五项指标各得零、一或二分：外观，也就是肤色；脉搏；皱眉反应，也就是对刺激的反应；活动，也就是肌张力；以及呼吸。身体红润、手脚发紫的孩子，外观得一分。脉搏超过一百得两分，低于一百得一分。大多数健康孩子得七分或以上。如果五分钟评分低于七分，就每五分钟再评一次，直到二十分钟。记住，Apgar 记录的是孩子的状况和对处理的反应，它不决定你什么时候开始复苏。

slides.q: At 1 minute: body pink, hands and feet blue, HR 110, grimaces when you flick the feet, arms and legs partly flexed, strong cry. What is the APGAR score?
slides.say: Let's score one. At one minute, the body is pink with blue hands and feet. Heart rate one hundred ten. The baby grimaces when you flick the feet, the arms and legs are partly flexed, and there's a strong cry. What's the APGAR score? A, five. B, six. C, seven. D, eight. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来算一个。一分钟时，身体红润、手脚发紫，心率一百一十，弹足底时皱眉，四肢部分屈曲，哭声响亮。Apgar 评分是多少？A 五分；B 六分；C 七分；D 八分。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is C, seven. Appearance scores one, because the hands and feet are still blue. Pulse scores two, because it's over one hundred. Grimace scores one; a cry would score two. Activity scores one for partial flexion. Respiration scores two for a strong cry. One plus two plus one plus one plus two is seven. Five and six undercount the pulse or the cry, and eight would need active movement or a cry when stimulated.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 C，七分。外观一分，因为手脚还发紫；脉搏两分，因为超过一百；皱眉反应一分，哭才得两分；活动一分，因为只是部分屈曲；呼吸两分，因为哭声响亮。一加二加一加一加二，等于七。五分和六分少算了脉搏或哭声；八分则需要四肢主动活动或刺激时会哭。

slides.title: BC newborn steps: 30 seconds each
slides.body:
BC: newborn floppy, limp, not breathing, or heart rate < 100

  1. Dry, stimulate, keep warm: 30 s
  2. HR still < 100 → BVM on room air: 30 s
  3. HR still < 100 → BVM with 100% O₂: 30 s
  4. HR still < 100 → compressions + ventilations + 100% O₂ until HR > 60

Neonate (up to 28 days): compressions 3:1, no AED.
slides.say: Here are the BC newborn resuscitation steps, and they apply to every licence level. They start when a newborn is floppy, limp, not breathing, or has a heart rate under one hundred. Step one: dry, stimulate and keep warm for thirty seconds. If the heart rate is still under one hundred, step two: ventilate with a bag-valve mask on room air for thirty seconds. Still under one hundred? Step three: keep ventilating, now with one hundred percent oxygen attached, for thirty seconds. Still under one hundred? Step four: chest compressions with ventilations and one hundred percent oxygen, until the heart rate is above sixty. In BC, a neonate, up to twenty-eight days old, gets compressions at three to one, and no AED.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的新生儿复苏步骤，适用于所有执照级别。新生儿松软、无力、没有呼吸，或心率低于一百时启动。第一步：擦干、刺激、保暖三十秒。心率仍低于一百，第二步：用球囊面罩以室内空气通气三十秒。还低于一百？第三步：继续通气，这次接上百分之百氧气，三十秒。还低于一百？第四步：胸外按压加通气和百分之百氧气，直到心率超过六十。在 BC，新生儿期，也就是出生二十八天以内，按压比例是三比一，不用 AED。

slides.title: Ventilating a newborn well
slides.body:
• Infant bag (about 240 mL): a breath is only 5–8 mL/kg
  • Mask over mouth and nose to the chin, not the eyes
  • Rate 40–60/min: squeeze on breathe, release on two, three
  • Squeeze only until the chest gently rises
  • First breaths may need more pressure: lungs are full of fluid
  • No chest rise? Fix the seal and head position first
slides.say: Ventilation is the most important skill in newborn resuscitation, because most slow heart rates in newborns come from low oxygen. Use an infant bag, about two hundred forty millilitres. A newborn breath is only five to eight millilitres per kilogram, so squeeze gently, just until the chest rises; too much volume can cause a pneumothorax. The mask covers the mouth and nose down to the chin, but not the eyes, because pressing on the eyes can slow the heart. Ventilate at forty to sixty a minute: squeeze on breathe, release on two, three. The first few breaths may need more pressure, because the lungs are still full of fluid. If the chest doesn't rise, check the seal and the head position first.
slides.sayZh: 通气是新生儿复苏中最重要的技能，因为新生儿心率慢大多是缺氧造成的。用婴儿球囊，约两百四十毫升。新生儿一口气只有每公斤五到八毫升，所以要轻轻捏，胸廓刚好抬起就够了，量太大会造成气胸。面罩罩住口鼻、下到下巴，但不能压到眼睛，因为压眼睛会让心跳变慢。通气频率每分钟四十到六十次：数「吸」时捏，数「二、三」时放。头几口可能需要更大的压力，因为肺里还充满液体。胸廓不起伏时，先检查面罩密封和头的位置。

slides.title: Compressions on a newborn
slides.body:
• Needed in fewer than 1% of births
  • Slow HR is usually hypoxia: make ventilation effective first
  • Two-thumb encircling technique is preferred
  • Thumbs on the lower sternum, just below the nipple line
  • About one-third of the chest depth; thumbs stay on the chest
  • BC: 3 compressions : 1 breath, with 100% O₂
slides.say: Chest compressions are rarely needed, in fewer than one percent of births. A newborn's heart slows mainly because of hypoxia, so before you compress, make sure your breaths are really moving the chest. When compressions are needed, the preferred method is the two-thumb technique: wrap your hands around the chest and place both thumbs on the lower sternum, just below the nipple line. Two fingers are the backup when you're alone. Press about one-third of the depth of the chest, and keep your thumbs in contact. In BC, the neonatal ratio is three compressions to one breath, with one hundred percent oxygen. That takes two rescuers: one compressing, one bagging.
slides.sayZh: 胸外按压很少需要，不到百分之一的分娩会用到。新生儿心跳变慢主要是因为缺氧，所以按压之前，先确认你的通气真的让胸廓起伏了。需要按压时，首选双拇指环抱法：双手环抱胸廓，两个拇指放在胸骨下段、乳头连线稍下方。只有一个人时用两指法作为备选。按压深度约为胸廓厚度的三分之一，拇指不离开胸壁。在 BC，新生儿按压与通气的比例是三比一，配合百分之百氧气。这需要两个人：一人按压，一人捏球囊。

slides.q: A term baby is limp and not breathing. After 30 s of drying and stimulation, HR is 80. You ventilate with a BVM on room air for 30 s with good chest rise; HR is still 80. Using the BC steps, what is next?
options: Ventilate with the BVM on 100% O₂ for 30 s, then reassess
Stop and calculate the APGAR score
slides.say: Now apply the BC steps. A term baby is limp and not breathing. After thirty seconds of drying and stimulation, the heart rate is eighty. You ventilate with a bag-valve mask on room air for thirty seconds, with good chest rise, and the heart rate is still eighty. What's next? A, start compressions at three to one right away. B, ventilate on one hundred percent oxygen for thirty seconds, then reassess. C, give epinephrine IM. D, stop and calculate the APGAR score. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 现在运用 BC 步骤。一个足月儿松软、没有呼吸。擦干刺激三十秒后，心率八十。你用球囊面罩以室内空气通气三十秒，胸廓起伏良好，心率仍是八十。下一步是什么？A 立即开始三比一按压；B 改用百分之百氧气通气三十秒，然后复评；C 肌注肾上腺素；D 停下来计算 Apgar 评分。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. You've finished step two, room air, and the heart rate is still under one hundred, so step three is the same ventilation with one hundred percent oxygen for thirty seconds. A skips step three. C is wrong because BC epinephrine is IM only, for anaphylaxis and severe bronchospasm, not for newborn resuscitation. D is wrong because the APGAR never decides when you act.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。你已完成第二步室内空气通气，心率仍低于一百，所以第三步是同样的通气，但接上百分之百氧气，持续三十秒。A 跳过了第三步。C 错，BC 的肾上腺素只能肌注，用于过敏性休克和严重支气管痉挛，不用于新生儿复苏。D 错，Apgar 从来不决定你何时行动。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the newborn in BC
slides.body:
The BC newborn steps sit in the CPR basics: every licence level runs them the same way.

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Dry, stimulate, warm: 30 s
  • BVM room air, then 100% O₂: 30 s each
  • Compressions 3:1 with 100% O₂ until HR > 60
  • Neonate: no AED

PCP adds

  • No drugs in the BC newborn steps
  • No IO, no drugs down a tube: not in scope
  • Lead: anticipate from the history, assign roles
  • Time each step, recheck HR, document times
slides.say: Here's an honest EMR versus PCP comparison. The BC newborn steps sit in the CPR basics, and every licence level runs them the same way: dry, stimulate and warm; ventilate on room air, then on one hundred percent oxygen; then compressions at three to one, with no AED for a neonate. There are no drugs in these steps for anyone, and IO access and drugs given down a tracheal tube are outside EMR and PCP scope. So what changes for you? You lead. You anticipate trouble from the history, assign roles before the birth, keep strict thirty-second timing, recheck the heart rate after every step, and document the times.
slides.sayZh: 这是一份实事求是的 EMR 与 PCP 对比。BC 新生儿复苏步骤写在 CPR 基础里，所有执照级别做法完全一样：擦干、刺激、保暖；先用室内空气通气，再用百分之百氧气；然后三比一按压，新生儿不用 AED。这些步骤里，任何级别都没有药物；骨髓腔通路和经气管导管给药，也不在 EMR 和 PCP 范围内。那你的变化在哪里？在于主导。你要从病史预判麻烦，在出生前分配好角色，严格掌握每段三十秒，每一步后复查心率，并记录时间。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Too much O₂ harms newborns, esp. preterm; follow SpO₂ once stable
  • Big or fast breaths → pneumothorax; watch the chest rise
  • Deep suction or a mask on the eyes → vagal bradycardia
  • Compressions fail if ventilation fails: fix the airway first
  • A cold baby transitions badly: warmth is treatment
  • Pale, not blue? Severe anemia can hide cyanosis: give O₂
slides.say: Here's what's new to watch for. Oxygen is a drug for newborns: too much is harmful, especially for preterm babies, so once the baby is stable, let the oximeter guide you. Big or fast breaths can cause a pneumothorax, so squeeze gently and watch the chest. Deep suctioning, or a mask pressing on the eyes, can trigger a vagal reflex and slow the heart. Compressions won't work if your ventilation doesn't, so fix the seal and head position first. A cold baby can't make the transition, so warmth is treatment, not comfort. And a pale baby may be severely anemic and hypoxic without looking blue, so give oxygen until you have a reliable saturation.
slides.sayZh: 新的注意事项如下。氧气对新生儿来说是一种药：给多了有害，早产儿尤其如此，所以孩子稳定后，要让血氧仪来指导你。通气量太大或太快可能造成气胸，所以要轻轻捏、看着胸廓。吸引太深或面罩压到眼睛，会触发迷走反射，让心跳变慢。通气无效，按压也不会有效，所以先解决面罩密封和头位。寒冷的孩子完成不了过渡，所以保暖是治疗，不只是让孩子舒服。还有，苍白的孩子可能严重贫血又缺氧，却看不出青紫，所以在拿到可靠的血氧读数前要给氧。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• BC: dry/warm → BVM room air → BVM 100% O₂, 30 s each
  • HR still < 100 → compressions + 100% O₂ until HR > 60
  • Book: compress when HR < 60 after 30 s of good PPV
  • Neonate (to 28 days): 3:1, no AED
  • Book: epinephrine IV or via tube → BC: IM only, not for this
  • No IO and no tracheal drugs in BC EMR/PCP scope
slides.say: Now the book versus BC. The book's algorithm starts compressions when the heart rate stays under sixty after thirty seconds of effective ventilation. The BC steps are written differently: thirty seconds each of warming, room-air ventilation and one hundred percent oxygen ventilation; then, if the heart rate is still under one hundred, compressions with ventilations and one hundred percent oxygen until it's above sixty. For the BC exam, know the BC wording. A neonate gets three to one and no AED. The book gives epinephrine into an umbilical vein or down a tracheal tube; in BC, epinephrine is IM only, for anaphylaxis and severe bronchospasm. IO access and tracheal drugs are outside EMR and PCP scope.
slides.sayZh: 现在对比原书和 BC。原书的流程是：有效通气三十秒后心率仍低于六十，才开始按压。BC 步骤的写法不同：保暖、室内空气通气、百分之百氧气通气，各三十秒；然后如果心率仍低于一百，就按压加通气和百分之百氧气，直到心率超过六十。考 BC 时要记住 BC 的原文。新生儿按压三比一，不用 AED。原书经脐静脉或气管导管给肾上腺素；在 BC，肾上腺素只能肌注，用于过敏性休克和严重支气管痉挛。骨髓腔通路和经气管给药不在 EMR 和 PCP 范围内。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Transition needs air, warmth and oxygen; cold and hypoxia stall it
  2. Decide from breathing, HR and colour, not the APGAR
  3. BC steps, 30 s each: warm → room air → 100% O₂ → compressions 3:1

Next: breathing problems, preterm babies, warmth, low sugar and transport
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: transition needs air, warmth and oxygen; cold, hypoxia and acidosis stall it, so warming and ventilating are real treatment. Two: decide on resuscitation from breathing, heart rate and colour, not from the APGAR. Take the heart rate at the cord or with a stethoscope, six seconds times ten. Three: the BC steps run thirty seconds each: warm and stimulate, room-air ventilation, ventilation with one hundred percent oxygen, then compressions at three to one until the heart rate is above sixty. Next lesson: breathing problems, preterm babies, keeping newborns warm, low blood sugar, and transport. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 记住三件事。一，过渡需要空气、温暖和氧气；寒冷、缺氧和酸中毒会让它停滞，所以保暖和通气是真正的治疗。二，是否复苏看呼吸、心率和肤色，而不是 Apgar；在脐带根部或用听诊器测心率，数六秒乘十。三，BC 步骤每段三十秒：保暖刺激、室内空气通气、百分之百氧气通气，然后三比一按压，直到心率超过六十。下节课讲呼吸问题、早产儿、新生儿保暖、低血糖和转运。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
